name: Takanami Chiaki
source:
A regular customer and aspiring designer studying at an art university.

A woman with an androgynous aura who also serves as a good confidant for the protagonist.

During the cafe's crises, she helps out behind the scenes—making waitress uniforms and flyers—despite being a customer.

[From [url=https://app.candysoft.jp/products/shibasoft/lovecoordination#chara]official site[/url]]
